December 21, 2000
From The American Medical Marijuana Association
http://www.drugsense.org/amma/

KUBBY JURY VERDICT UPHOLDS OAKLAND GUIDELINES

Jurors upheld the Oakland Guidelines and hung 11-1 to acquit Steve and Michele Kubby of all marijuana charges. See
Oakland City Council Votes To Allow Patients One And Half Pounds Of Medical Marijuana

Except for the one hold-out juror, the jury recognized and supported the Guidelines.
(MarijuanaNews note: Seventy years of reefer madness is difficult to overcome. I had expected that there would be a few more hold-outs despite the prosecution’s wretched behavior.)
See
Local Editor Says Kubby Prosecution " Ends with a Whimper. "

Michele Kubby was acquitted of all remaining charges.

Steve Kubby was found guilty of felony possession of a mushroom stem and a minute quantity of peyote. The jury had originally voted to acquit, but reversed itself and voted to convict today, after having the legal definition of a usable quantity re-read to them. Steve will return on February 2 for sentencing.

 " We won the important battle for recognition of the Oakland Guidelines. Even in conservative Placer County, jurors will not convict a bona fide patient who follows the Oakland Guidelines. The other charges are unfortunate, but we'll deal with that issue at the appropriate time. " Said Kubby.
(MarijuanaNews note: These other charges pose no real threat to Steve, but now the Kubbys have to put their lives back together. The seizure of their computers and the expense of fighting for two years has left them bankrupt and essentially homeless.
See
The Rule of Lawlessness: Police Brazenness In The Kubby Case.
The Fourth And Fifth Amendments, Or Forfeiture and Thievery. The Choice Is Ours.
and links.

I hope that the Kubbys will write a book about their ordeal at the hands of sociopathic prosecutors and police who nearly killed him. I also hope that the Libertarian Party will continue to champion medical marijuana. They should have nominated Steve for Vice President.
See
Kubby Finishes Second in Close Race for Libertarian VP Nomination. Convention Speakers and Nominees Make Clear Libertarians Are The Anti-Prohibitionist Party. Special to MarijuanaNews

Now the Kubbys will have more time to devote to The American Medical Marijuana Association, which is greatly needed to protect patients who are less resourceful than they.

Finally, it must never be forgotten that none of this would be possible without the tireless work of the defense attorneys, Tony Serra and David Nick, who worked pro bono.)
